propositions: Task and story that are both direct children of an epic cannot hold a direct dependency under the type-tier rule; the resolver incorrectly promotes to the epic, creating an invalid ancestor-blocking edge
Blocking link redundancy is evaluated before promotion, allowing resolved pairs that violate ancestor-descendant constraints to be written to the store
Comparability should be determined by shared parent hierarchy rather than ticket type tier, so cross-subtree dependencies escalate to the nearest common ancestor's children
The existing _get_ancestors function is capped at two hops and lacks cycle-guard protection, causing it to fail on chains deeper than epic-story-task or malformed parent cycles
Resolution must reject blocking edges between resolved endpoints in an ancestor-descendant relationship regardless of whether the original pair was direct parent-child
